visualReview.scope: Final full-page composed ledger readable; second and third preview costs and approval controls visible. First viewport screenshot ends above the preview; its complete displayed preview is retained in the accessibility snapshot and exact HTTP payload.

scope: Three actual UI paper approvals on the separately authorized seeded synthetic isolation fixture, without resetting its existing ledger. Ordinary authentication path (demo flag false). This is route coverage, not exhaustive testing of all 12 directed asset pairs.
priorHarnessCorrections: Initial run required demo flag on an explicitly authorized ordinary-login synthetic account; stopped before approvals. Guard now verifies exact fixture identity plus authoritative paper-only readiness.

Second run waited on an event counter before a browser RPC, starving synchronous Playwright response dispatch. Preview rendered, but no approval occurred. Third run records browser RPC delivery diagnostics.
